detaileddescription.para: Screen is placed inside a juce::Viewport by whelmed::Component. It builds blocks incrementally as the parser completes, lays them out vertically, and paints them in a single paint() pass. Mouse events drive selection; InputHandler reads the selection state via app::ID properties on the shared ValueTree.
